newsitem.title: UK: Manser to be Fleming's chairman in New Year - paper.
newsitem.headline: Manser to be Fleming's chairman in New Year - paper.

text.p: John Manser, chief executive of Robert Fleming, will become the company's chairman at the start of 1997, the Sunday Telegraph newspaper reported.

He will succeed Robin Fleming, who is due to retire. The report said the decision had yet to be agreed by the board, but Manser is said to be the choice of the Fleming family, who speak for about 35 percent of the shares.
The report also said the family had put a price of 2.96 billion stg ($4.73 billion), or 20 stg per share, on the company.
